email.incident_report_intro: A file download attempt was blocked by the Attachment Security module.
email.footer: This is an automated notification from FreeScout Attachment Security Module.
default.block_message: For security reasons the file {filename} cannot be downloaded. If you need access to this content, please contact support.
default.encrypted_archive_block_message: The file {filename} is password-protected and cannot be scanned for security reasons.
default.unreadable_archive_block_message: The file {filename} cannot be scanned because it appears to be corrupted or has an invalid format. For security reasons, the download has been blocked.
